create_DeepNeurdModel: create a deep feedforward neural network model for neural replicator dynamics with configurable hidden layers and skip connections
train_NeuRD_model: train a NeuRD model on counterfactual regret data using SGD with thresholded logits and optional autoencoder loss
build_CounterfactualNeurdSolver: build a counterfactual regret solver that performs policy evaluation and improvement steps for two-player zero-sum games
apply_thresholded_logits: apply thresholding to logits and regrets to zero out values that are too negative or too large
evaluate_and_update_policy: evaluate and update a NeuRD policy by computing counterfactual regrets and training models on sequence features
